name: Call of Air
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The winds of Kalimdor rush to meet you and you shall be counted among some of our most powerful  brothers. I am proud to see you have come this far and have such a promising future.

The element of air is a difficult one to control, but I have faith that your skills will overcome any obstacles that are placed in front of you.

Head to the very south of the Barrens, and enter Thousand Needles. It is there, far to the east, that you will find Prate Cloudseer. She will teach you more.
narrative.objectives: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
narrative.offerRewardText: For the time being. I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
